findings.input: YYYY-MM-DD and YYYY-MM-DD 00:00:00 in the same date column, both row orders
findings.observed: Single-format inference rejects valid timezone-naive midnight dates, including aligned-close and unchanged-freeze consumers. Candidate hashing drops valid intermediate mixed-format dates and yields the same hash for 2026-09-02 versus 2026-09-03 midnight text; the old verifier rejects such frames before acceptance, so no old end-to-end migration bypass is claimed.
findings.narrow_fix: Parse dates per element or with format=mixed; preserve NaT, timezone, midnight and duplicate-session rejection. Canonical candidate hashing must validate and retain every date.

findings.input: Two event rows: valid first row; second row has legal mixed midnight label or missing/NaT/invalid rebalance date, including an infinite-cost variant.
findings.observed: The real embedded loader reads 2 CSV rows and returns 1 after errors=coerce/dropna; costs become 0.001 instead of 0.003, or the malformed/infinite-cost event disappears entirely.
findings.narrow_fix: All turnover consumers must validate raw events before filtering; use one fail-closed turnover loader and never drop parse failures.

findings.input: One rebalance event repeated twice with rate 0.006
findings.observed: All three routes accept duplicate events; mapper charges 0.012.
findings.narrow_fix: Reject duplicate canonical rebalance-event identities before summing.

findings.input: Result sessions 2026-09-04/07/08; rebalance_date Saturday 2026-09-05, execution_date Monday 2026-09-07
findings.observed: Valid explicit execution session hides an impossible inside-window signal date; mapper accepts the event.
findings.narrow_fix: Require rebalance_date to be present when it lies within the supplied session window; retain valid explicit pre-window events.

findings.input: One stream contains close and next_open events; identical signals and event records are supplied in reversed row order.
findings.observed: Entry/exit costs change from [0.003,0,0.003] to [0,0.003,0] because the first event controls the whole signal stream.
findings.narrow_fix: Reject mixed timing streams for a strategy-wide timing model; preserve both legal uniform timing modes.

findings.input: All cells are genuinely missing on both sides; np.nan/None/pd.NA representation changes.
findings.observed: All 6 representation/namespace variants incorrectly report a historical rewrite.
findings.narrow_fix: Mask both-genuinely-missing cells before the final changed decision while preserving the raw isna XOR and missing-to-literal-string rejection.

findings.input: All exact hashes and other evidence match, but JSON approved is integer 1.
findings.observed: All 3 verifiers accept integer 1 via equality to True; genuine boolean approved controls pass and 12 tampered-hash controls remain rejected.
findings.narrow_fix: Require report.approved is True before evaluating the unchanged exact-hash evidence. No arbitrary-hash bypass was demonstrated.
